summary: B1 was already fixed in place by the adjudication commit. The A1 ruling is now in P4: kubeconform's sibling container sees only host paths, the gate must get the rendered manifests to it, and a run that validates zero resources fails the build (verified mounts, no chart-less prd release). V19 covers it, the checked scope now includes the post-renderer charts, and close-out S3 notes the kubectl-applied manifests the gate never sees.
